title: Great idea... but missed the mark. Cancelled after 1st box.
text: Who doesn’t need to be spoiled and encouraged to take care of themselves? Everyone... but sadly, this box missed the mark. I mean... Salt and pepper shakers?? I don’t care that they are shaped like rocks, salt and pepper shakes don’t make me want to self care.  That was a true disappointment. And I cancelled. The rest of the box was ok; a few face masks,  a facial roller, and a self care planner. But not worth the price in my opinion.
label: negative
